title: Вынос engine.py по слоям: domain → infrastructure/files → policies → infrastructure/roles → stages → application; реэкспорт публичных имён; модули ≤ 600 строк
summary: По knowledge/p11-refactor#extract: шаг за шагом с зелёными characterization и тестами после каждого; классы только Conductor и RunStore; функции для правил; engine.py — фасад с реэкспортом.
why: Аудит П10.2, мысль 7. Риски: (1) регрессия — characterization; (2) поломка импортов CLI и мостов — реэкспорт и `rg -n 'from orch.conductor.engine import|engine\.' packages bridges` до и после.
rules: Дизайн — разделы knowledge из reads; имена команд, полей, кодов, путей — строго оттуда; расхождение с кодом — open_issues отчёта kind deviation
Поведение conductor не меняется: characterization и существующие тесты зелёные после каждого шага
Один слой — один коммит (plan.py commit с юнитом при необходимости)
guidance: Исполнитель: frontier/high. Порядок слоёв как в дизайне; после каждого: characterization + affected-tests; затем V1.

validation.cmd: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; big=[(p,sum(1 for _ in open(p))) for p in pathlib.Path('packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor').rglob('*.py')]; bad=[x for x in big if x[1]>600]; assert not bad, bad"

result.notes:
engine.py (3100 lines) is split by layer in the order of knowledge/p11-refactor#extract: domain (stop.py Stop, item.py Item, report.py: answer parsers, report_problems, findings_problems, evidence_paths, continued, blocked, notes) -> infrastructure/files.py (write_json, read_json, runs_root, safe, run constants, new RunStore for run.json/state.json/options copy/agent numbers) + infrastructure/clock.py (the time seams) -> policies (allowance.py with pure over_target/batch_used/piece_count, routing.py, sandbox.py, retry_policy.py around retry.decide, risk.py, budget.py, skills.py) -> infrastructure/roles.py (role process, agent runs, argv/env, repair) + infrastructure/work_source.py (every orch.py source verb incl. register and commit taken out of finish) -> stages (scout, research, context, execute, checks_stage, review, triage, advice, close, finish) -> application (run_service.py: run/resume/retry/release/settle; loop.py: loop, pieces, claim, conduct, step, resolve). engine.py (305 lines) is a facade: Conductor keeps the run and binds the layer functions as its methods under the old names, so self-calls, Conductor.__new__ tests and mock.patch.object(Conductor, ...) work unchanged; public names are re-exported (__all__). The only classes are Conductor and RunStore. prompts.py (711) moved its answer parsers to domain/report.py, budgets to policies/budget.py and skill checks to policies/skills.py, re-exporting them (580). Behaviour unchanged: after every layer, characterization plus all test_conductor*/test_contracts*/test_conformance files (bash scripts/test.sh -p 'test_c[oh]*.py', 545 tests) passed; also test_gates, test_native_conformance, test_risk, test_boundaries, test_adhoc, ecosystem-units check and conduct.py --help.

deviations: Test seams moved: patching engine.sleep, engine.unit_random, engine._mono or engine.ORCH_ROOT no longer reaches the moved code. test_characterization.py and test_conductor.py now patch infrastructure.clock (sleep, unit_random, mono) and policies.sandbox.ORCH_ROOT. The names are still re-exported from engine, but patching them there has no effect.

Module names beyond knowledge/p11-refactor#extract: infrastructure/clock.py (the time seams), policies/skills.py (check_skills from prompts.py), stages/research.py, stages/advice.py (P10 advisor), plus policies/budget.py and stages/context.py (from the audit). RunStore lives in infrastructure/files.py. Stateful steps are module functions that take the conductor as self and are bound as Conductor methods, rather than functions with fully explicit arguments; only the stateless rules are pure functions.

The existing modules the design also assigns to folders (progress.py -> infrastructure, gates.py -> policies, checks/process/scope/observer/options/heal) were not moved; only engine.py was extracted. prompts.py was split only as far as V2 needs (parsers, budgets, skill checks moved out, re-exported).
pending: For P11.3: every orch.py source verb (claim, release, brief, prepare, research, register, commit) and the brief's artifacts_dir are already in infrastructure/work_source.py, and no code calls plan.py. These places outside it still write into item.artifacts: stages/advice.py:63 (advice-N.json), stages/finish.py:40 (stage-report.json), stages/review.py:180 (review-verdict.json), and stages/checks_stage.py:94 (evidence_dir passed to checks.run_checks). stages/close.py builds the register command line for the closer role.
